Uses of Enum Class
com.eqixiac.equinix.fabric.model.implementation.cloud.CloudProviderType

Packages that use CloudProviderType
Package
Description
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer
The Metro Optimization Engine: scores, ranks, and selects Equinix metros for a deployment from user sites, provider requirements, workloads, and constraints, against live Fabric catalog data.
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.wizard.model
Value types for the Deployment Wizard — the plan itself and everything it is made of, plus the execution-side inputs and outcomes.
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.ratecard
Rate cards: pluggable sources of unit prices for the design-time cost, savings, and TCO models.
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.ratecard.provider
Live cloud-provider pricing adapters: RateCard implementations that source current data-egress list prices from the providers' public pricing APIs — AwsPriceListRateCard (AWS Price List bulk offers), AzureRetailPricesRateCard (Azure Retail Prices), GcpBillingCatalogRateCard (GCP Cloud Billing Catalog; the only one needing an API key), and OracleCloudPriceListRateCard (OCI Price List).
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.savings
Cloud-egress savings estimation: how much routing a monthly data volume over an Equinix private interconnect saves versus egressing it to the public internet, net of the Equinix interconnect cost.
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.tco
Design-time total-cost-of-ownership comparison across three DeploymentArchetypes — public cloud over the internet, on-premises, and Equinix-interconnected.
com.eqixiac.equinix.fabric.model.implementation.cloud
Cloud provider SDK interoperability layer for Equinix Fabric connections.
com.eqixiac.equinix.mcp.server
The embedded Equinix Intelligence MCP Server — a community Model Context Protocol server, not affiliated with or endorsed by Equinix, and unrelated to Equinix's own private-beta Fabric MCP server.

    ReferenceRateCard.cspInterconnectPortMonthly(CloudProviderType provider, int bandwidthMbps)
    The indicative monthly fee for a cloud provider's interconnect port/circuit (AWS Direct Connect / Azure ExpressRoute / GCP Interconnect) at or above the requested bandwidth.
    Optional<PriceQuote>
    ReferenceRateCard.cspInterconnectPortMonthlyQuote(CloudProviderType provider, int bandwidthMbps)
    As ReferenceRateCard.cspInterconnectPortMonthly(CloudProviderType, int), returning the fee as a tagged PriceQuote: an at-or-above tabulated tier carries a plain reference note, while a request above the top tier carries a note flagging the figure as EXTRAPOLATED above top tabulated tier so it is never mistaken for a tabulated rate.
